symday.title: SymDay
symday.description: A symptom tracker that records each symptom on a user-defined scale and plots them together on a single graph, prioritizing trends over exact values.
symday.imageAlt: SymDay landing page with hero text: Symptom tracking calibrated to you. There are sign up and try demo buttons below that.
symday.role: Product, UX and accessibility, full-stack development
